ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of childcare fraud cases to identify patterns and connections between entities and programs.
questions: What are the most common methods of childcare fraud?
How can childcare programs be better protected against exploitation?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial aspects of childcare fraud, we can gain a deeper understanding of how these schemes operate and identify potential vulnerabilities in the system.
